jobs.objective: REVISE the v1 RFC 0167 P0 implementation SPEC to resolve the two cycle-1 binding constraints C1 and C2, carrying forward UNREGRESSED everything v1 cleared. Start from the v1 HOLDER.md (a required context doc) — do NOT rewrite from scratch; the v1 cycle-1 collaboration ledger (also required context) gives the exact prescribed fixes in its findings and constraints blocks. Read the v2 SEED, the v1 HOLDER.md, the v1 ledger, and the RFC in full first. DISCHARGE C1 (R1b sufficiency, critical): v1's per-session-handle proof needs a pre-run operator session whose token sets app.session_id at run.prepare, but current source cannot create one — sessions.run_id is text NOT NULL with an FK to runs (0005_repo_local_workflow_state.sql:44-66) and HandleRegisterSession requires run_id/role/lane (lifecycle.go:41-46), so mintSessionBoundToken is structurally run-bound; without the operator session created_by_handle_id is NULL and both same-human runs collapse to maya#7f3. Name the pre-run operator-session STORAGE + LIFECYCLE explicitly — resolve the run_id NOT NULL FK by EITHER making run_id nullable with an operator-session role or state OR a dedicated operator-session table (pick one, justify, anchor to source; an ALTER of an owner-held table folds into owner bundle 0021) — and specify heartbeat, graceful close, lazy expiry, and the run->operator_handles join WITHOUT leaning on run-scoped closeRemainingSessions. It MUST stay a REUSE of RFC 0107 session machinery (mintSessionBoundToken, the principal_clients link, the prelude GUC), not a rebuild; show how striatum operator bootstrap becomes the daemon-side mint+lease entry that creates the operator session+token the CLI presents on run.prepare. Add pgtest operator_session_pre_run_stamp (two-role): two pre-run operator sessions for ONE human lease two distinct words, one run per session, assert two NON-NULL DISTINCT created_by_handle_id and whose RA != whose RB. DISCHARGE C2 (R2 and R4 two-role safety, critical): v1's run-origin INSERT reads principal_clients.principal_id DIRECTLY, but owner bundle 0006 REVOKEs SELECT on that column from striatumd_rw and grants back only (client_id, linked_at, unlinked_at) (0006_identity_read_scope.sql:218-221; owner.go:454-468) — so the stamp fails 42501 under the two-role fixture. Route the run-origin principal stamp AND the lease-acquisition principal resolution through striatumd.resolve_principal_for_client / admin.ResolvePrincipalForClient inside the authorized transaction — NEVER a direct principal_clients.principal_id read — and do NOT grant SELECT(principal_id) back to striatumd_rw. Specify the exact mechanism (resolve the principal in Go and bind as a parameter, or call the SECURITY DEFINER projection function in SQL; confirm striatumd_rw can call it). Add pgtest run_origin_stamp_uses_identity_projection (two-role): (a) a direct pc.principal_id read fails 42501 as a control, (b) the projection-routed stamp succeeds storing the right principal, (c) a forged envelope or request param cannot affect the stored value. CARRY FORWARD UNREGRESSED (the v1 adjudicator discharged these; do not reopen or weaken): R1a honesty (A1-A5), the R1b ARCHITECTURE (per-session created_by_handle_id snapshot + live-unique partial index + the deterministic principal-seeded escalation walk + the run->handle_id join), R1c flap renewal (A12, guarded UPDATE), the R2 BEFORE UPDATE write-once trigger + owner bundle ordinal 0021, R3's four open-question resolutions, R4 reuse, and the four C-1..C-4 source corrections. Open the revised SPEC with an auditable 'Addressing the v1 cycle-1 constraints' map (C1 RESOLVED how, C2 RESOLVED how, carry-forwards INTACT) so the falsifiers can verify. This is the published claim the falsifiers re-attack.
